text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction continuing the prior scene into reported speech
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) makes the confession arrive as the next beat after the no-escape closure of 34:51, not as a fresh start. The connector keeps the prior seizure scene audible before the speech verb begins: their words are structurally downstream from panic, capture, and failed flight. Because the particle coordinates without naming a cause, it lets context supply the pressure while preserving the visible sequence into reported speech.

topics.headline: continuation from 34:51
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the late confession is carried forward from the prior no-escape scene (34:51), not introduced as independent initiative.
topics.reason: QAC marks the opening as a conjunction attached before the speech verb, and the boundary rows tie it to the preceding closure (34:51).

words.gloss_range: reported saying, declaration, and speech-act framing for the quoted confession
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, articulation, claim, attribution, and dialogue branches; local Form I perfect selects their own completed utterance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: quoted belief claim with its prepositional object

words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) assigns the confession to the seized group as their own completed speech act. Its quote complement, {{ar:ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:āmannā bihi}}), means the ayah is evaluating a voiced claim rather than narrating inward faith as a settled fact. The plain Form I perfect keeps imposed speech, fabricated-speech morphology, and dialogue alternatives outside the local form; what remains is accountable utterance, immediately measured by the access-denial that follows.

topics.headline: seized group speaks for itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group acted upon in 34:51 becomes verbally active in 34:52 through its own completed utterance.
topics.reason: Subject agreement and discourse reference identify the speakers, while the perfect active Form I verb makes the utterance theirs.

topics.headline: speech recorded but not validated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word records an audible claim without granting that the confession now functions as saving faith.
topics.reason: The speech-root rows fit the local reported utterance, with false-attribution and dialogue branches limited by the actual Form I surface.

topics.headline: reported claim then access-denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief enters as quoted speech and is then judged by reach, with late-speech parallels after disclosure (23:99-100).
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the belief clause the quote governed by the speech verb, and the inter-ayah rows remain bounded by concrete late-speech comparisons (23:99-100).

words.gloss_range: claimed belief/trust voiced as a completed first-person plural statement inside the quote
words.root_gloss_range: belief, trust, and security-seeking pressure; local Form IV perfect selects a claimed entry into belief/trust rather than grammaticalized protection-seeking

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional object of the belief claim

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنَّا}} ({{tr:āmannā}}) gives the seized deniers a first-person plural voice, but only inside their own quote. The perfect form presents belief as already accomplished in their speech, while the narrator’s following question asks whether such completed wording can still become access. The belief/trust/security range remains meaningful: with {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}), the claim sounds like attachment to the rejected truth, yet the far-place ending shows that attachment and safety are now voiced from the wrong position.

topics.headline: quoted claim, not narrator verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is their self-reported completion of belief, not the narrator’s validation that effective faith has occurred.
topics.reason: The verb is a first common plural perfect inside the quoted clause governed by the speech verb, and the next clause evaluates its reach.

topics.headline: belief sounds like trust-seeking attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confession is not bare assent; it also sounds like a late attempt to attach to trust and safety through its prepositional object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the governed prepositional object, and missing V4 rows for this root do not block the CRITICAL belief/trust/security range.

topics.headline: late recognition after refusal (34:31; 40:84-85)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the faith-root returns after prior refusal (34:31) and joins the late-belief pattern where recognition under punishment no longer benefits (40:84-85).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows preserve a concrete reversal and late-recognition pattern, while the local quote and distance clause keep the effect anchored in 34:52.

words.gloss_range: prepositional object of belief with a discourse-bound masculine singular suffix
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) keeps the object of belief compact and discourse-bound. The preposition makes the claim relational, while the suffix points back to the already rejected truth or message rather than introducing a fresh object inside the quote. Because the whole object is compressed into one short phrase, the confession closes quickly and hands the ayah over to the question of whether this late attachment can reach.

topics.headline: pronoun keeps the believed object prior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote depends on a prior rejected object, so the ayah stresses late attachment more than renaming what is believed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the preposition-plus-suffix as the belief complement and links the suffix to prior truth or message discourse.

topics.headline: short attachment channel before denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the short phrase makes belief sound like leaning on an access channel, immediately before the ayah denies access.
topics.reason: The bāʾ relation is locally governed by the belief verb; instrumentality remains only a secondary pressure within object-attachment.

words.gloss_range: second conjunction pivoting from quoted claim to narratorial denial of attainability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted interrogative opening the impossibility clause

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) is the hinge from their quote to the narrator’s impossibility clause. It carries contrast by placement rather than by an explicit adversative: the claim stands beside the access-denial and collapses there. Its attachment to {{ar:أَنَّىٰ}} ({{tr:annā}}) visibly resets the clause, so the ayah can move from reported speech to evaluation without adding another speech verb.

topics.headline: contrast without explicit adversative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial emerges from juxtaposition: the confession is not refuted by a separate label but by being joined directly to impossibility.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following clause as a narratorial contrast after the quote, while the particle itself remains formally coordinative.

words.gloss_range: fronted interrogative of how/whence functioning as denial of feasible access
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّىٰ}} ({{tr:annā}}) puts impossibility first. It asks how, whence, or by what route the grasp could be theirs, but the distance phrase later supplies the negative answer. Because it fronts the nominal clause before the claimants and the access noun, the requested reaching arrives already under denial rather than as an action that simply fails after being tried.

topics.headline: fronted question as denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause states non-availability as a rhetorical question before the sought access-process is even named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the interrogative the fronted predicate of the nominal clause, and translation support warns against flattening it into a neutral location question.

topics.headline: how and whence fail together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that method and source-location are denied together; the later far-place phrase answers both sides of the question.
topics.reason: The polysemy rows are locally licensed by the following source phrase, which makes route and means inseparable in the denial.

words.gloss_range: lām of availability, possession, benefit, or entitlement in the split phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted availability phrase identifying the denied beneficiaries

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) creates the denied availability relation. Before the access noun appears, the clause asks whether that reaching can be for, to, or available to the speakers. The split analysis of {{ar:لَهُمُ}} ({{tr:lahumu}}) keeps both halves visible: the preposition creates the possible share, and the following pronoun names the group from whom that share is withheld.

topics.headline: availability and entitlement denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the issue is not abstract existence of grasping but whether this process can be theirs as benefit, possession, or access.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs the pronoun by the lām and links the phrase to the access noun as the availability relation.

topics.headline: claimants before access noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claimants are placed under scrutiny before the process they want is named.
topics.reason: The local word order puts the prepositional predicate before the delayed subject, matching the CRITICAL ordering claim.

words.gloss_range: third masculine plural pronoun identifying the denied beneficiaries as the same speakers

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first-person plural belief claim inside the quote

words.prose: {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}) locks the denied availability onto the same plural speakers who just said {{ar:ءَامَنَّا}} ({{tr:āmannā}}). The question is therefore not a general claim about human access; it is a verdict on this known group. The move from their first-person plural claim to third-person scrutiny changes the voice: they speak for themselves, then the narrator assesses whether access can belong to them.

topics.headline: known group, not generic humanity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied beneficiaries are the same known speakers, tracked from seizure to confession to failed access.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence links the pronoun to the speakers of the quoted confession, and the lām construction makes them the potential recipients.

topics.headline: first-person claim becomes third-person scrutiny
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from self-claim to narrator-framed assessment before the access noun is pronounced.
topics.reason: The ordering and recitation rows add a distinct payoff to the same pronoun chain: recipient and access noun are joined while the relation is denied.

words.gloss_range: definite Form VI verbal noun for reaching, grasping, or attempted retrieval under denial
words.root_gloss_range: reaching to take, grasping, obtaining, skirmishing at reach, or rescuing by reaching; local clause selects impossible remedial access from a far place
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ}} ({{tr:al-tanāwush}}) is the ayah’s rare access-word. As a definite Form VI verbal noun and delayed subject, it names the process of reaching itself as the impossible thing, not a completed rescue or a failed finite action. Its tactile range makes the late confession physical: it is as though a hand tries to retrieve from beyond reach. The accepted hamzated variant preserves the same syntactic denial while sharpening the sound of interrupted access, and the boundary from near seizure in 34:51 to failed reach in 34:52 makes distance decisive.

topics.headline: access process named under denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the process of reaching is the delayed subject already placed under impossibility and denied availability.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a definite verbal noun and delayed subject completed by the far-place source phrase.

topics.headline: rare tactile reaching vocabulary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that late belief is framed through a rare tactile reach-word, so the crisis becomes failed retrieval from beyond grasp rather than generic non-attainment.
topics.reason: V4 supports the reaching/grasping branch, and the contextual summary marks the local exact form as uniquely concentrated rather than formulaic.

topics.headline: accepted variant changes sound, not syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hamzated reading can make broken access audible while the clause still denies the same access noun in the same syntactic role.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows are retained as form and sound evidence, but narrowed because they do not change the canonical delayed-subject role or local access sense.

topics.headline: 34:51 near seizure becomes 34:52 failed reach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the near capture of 34:51 is answered by a reach-word in 34:52, while the late-belief principle also aligns with recognition after punishment (40:84-85).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows preserve concrete links to 34:51 and 40:84-85, while the local source phrase prevents the parallels from overriding the immediate syntax.

words.gloss_range: source and separation preposition introducing the far-place phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: place noun governed by the source preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the far place the starting point from which the impossible grasp would have to occur. Its source sense and separation sense work together: the action begins from a location already cut off from the object of reach. Because the preposition stands separately before {{ar:مَّكَانٍۭ}} ({{tr:makānin}}), the closing phrase explains the denial by making distance internal to the origin of the attempted access.

topics.headline: source is already separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that failure is built into the starting point: the grasp would have to begin from a place already marked as separated.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following place noun the governed complement of the preposition and ties the whole phrase to the access noun.

topics.headline: source and place audibly bound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source marker join the place noun, reinforcing that source and place form one dependency.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds audible support to a syntactically forced prepositional dependency.

words.gloss_range: indefinite noun of place/position governed by the source preposition and qualified by distance
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurrence, place, position, and rank; local noun-of-place form selects a locus or state from which access is attempted
words.prose: {{ar:مَّكَانٍۭ}} ({{tr:makānin}}) gives the denial a source-location without naming a map point. Its indefiniteness generalizes the barrier: any place characterized by the following remoteness is enough to defeat the grasp. The k-w-n field is narrowed here into a noun of place or position, so the word makes their present standing into the condition from which access fails. Across 34:51-53, the repeated place frame turns near capture into far failed access and then into another far-place failure.

topics.headline: indefinite place becomes general barrier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not need a named location; an indefinite place qualified by distance is enough to make access fail.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the source preposition, indefinite, and qualified by the following adjective, so the place functions as a generalized access condition.

topics.headline: being-field narrowed to place or standing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that place is also a standing or condition, while the local noun-of-place form keeps that pressure anchored in a source location.
topics.reason: V4 supports place, position, and rank from the root, but local grammar narrows broad being or formation language to a noun of place/position rather than a finite becoming event.

topics.headline: 34:51-53 repeated place frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same place frame across 34:51-53 lets the adjective reversal carry the movement from near capture to far failed access.
topics.reason: The boundary and echo rows name concrete local references (34:51-53), and the local adjective relation confirms that place and distance form one access-barrier unit.

words.gloss_range: qualitative adjective of remoteness attached to the place noun as the final barrier
words.root_gloss_range: remoteness, afterness, separation, exclusion, and relational distance; local adjective selects settled far-ness as the access-blocking quality

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: place noun qualified by the final adjective

words.prose: {{ar:بَعِيدٍۢ}} ({{tr:baʿīdin}}) seals the ayah on distance rather than on confession. As a qualitative adjective agreeing with {{ar:مَّكَانٍۭ}} ({{tr:makānin}}), it attaches remoteness to the source place itself, not to a passing mood. Its range lets spatial, temporal, and relational distance converge: they believe from where grasp is no longer near. The near-to-far reversal from 34:51 to 34:52 and the repeated far-place phrase in 34:53 make the final word the boundary’s access-barrier.

topics.headline: remoteness belongs to the place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remoteness is a settled quality of the source place, making the final phrase one compact access-barrier rather than a decorative description.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms adjective agreement with the place noun, and V4 supports the local remoteness branch for the adjective.

topics.headline: distance judges late belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final distance word evaluates the earlier confession by showing why claimed trust can no longer reach.
topics.reason: The local adjective selects remoteness and separation as the explanatory tail of the rhetorical question, with spatial and temporal pressure bounded by the far-place phrase.

topics.headline: 34:51-53 near-far boundary and 41:44 far-place motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 34:51 answers near seizure with far failed access in 34:52, then 34:53 repeats the far-place phrase; 41:44 supplies a related far-reception motif.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references for the near-to-far transition (34:51-53) and the far-place comparison (41:44), while the local final adjective remains the governing payoff.

baseline_models.mechanism: An overt speech act claims an inward, heart-settling assent; the construction keeps the declaration channel and the trust-state analytically distinct.

activation_trace.role: Emission of articulated speech supplies the overt declaration and frames faith as something said.
Assent in which the heart becomes settled supplies the inward state that the utterance claims.

changed_reading.before: They simply state that they now believe.
changed_reading.after: They voice a claim to settled assent, while the ayah leaves open whether saying can now install the state it names.

baseline_models.mechanism: Reaching requires an extension that closes an interval; place fixes the origin and distance puts the object outside that reach envelope.

activation_trace.role: Taking by extension and arriving at an object supplies the focus action of grasping across an interval.
Place or position supplies the situated origin from which the attempt is made.
Spatial or immaterial remoteness supplies the interval that the attempted extension cannot close.

changed_reading.before: Faith is simply unavailable to them.
changed_reading.after: The failure is mechanically relational: from their present position they cannot extend to and take hold of the claimed object.

baseline_models.mechanism: The reach-root can describe either making something arrive to another or taking a stricken one out of destruction, so the question can deny both self-grasping and an incoming rescue transfer.

activation_trace.role: Causing good or harm to reach another supplies an other-directed transfer channel.
Taking hold of an afflicted one to extract or save them supplies the rescue function of that channel.
Remoteness supplies the gap across which neither delivery nor extraction can operate.

changed_reading.after: No saving handoff or extraction is available to them across the distance.

baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative of whence, manner, or time is colored by the same root's image of reaching ripeness; combined with laterness and reaching, distance can be temporal as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: Questioning place, manner, condition, or time supplies the overt challenge to possibility.
A thing attaining its proper time or ripeness supplies a latent acquisition window.
What comes after what was before supplies temporal separation from that window.
Reaching and taking supplies the acquisition that must occur while the window is live.

changed_reading.before: The question asks how they can reach across space.
changed_reading.after: It may also ask how an acquisition can ripen after its proper moment has receded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Saba sequence first constructs an inspectable, measured relay of settlements for safe travel, then has its users request longer intervals and become torn apart. The focus's far place therefore functions as the endpoint of dismantled connectivity, not an unexplained coordinate.

activation_trace.role: Extension that arrives at and takes an object supplies the focus's required traversal.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies the relay relation joining the settlements.
Going and flowing supplies successful traversal through the connected route.
Settled security against fear marks the original route as safely reachable.
Actively causing distance supplies the request to enlarge the intervals that must be crossed.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the route-network's collapse into separation.

structural_cues: 34:18's safe measured chain immediately precedes 34:19's request for greater distance.
34:19 couples that spoken request with self-wronging and total dispersion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies safe measured links, a request for greater distance, and subsequent dispersion; I treat that history as a causal spatial analogue for 34:52. A live alternative is that the final distance is solely eschatological rather than self-produced.

changed_reading.before: They happen to stand too far away to grasp what they now claim.
changed_reading.after: Their unreachable position is the accumulated result of converting a traversable chain of nearness into separated intervals.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promise becomes a fixed appointment that cannot be moved backward or forward; regret follows sight of punishment, while truth has already arrived. The focus's distance is thus the wrong side of an irreversible event boundary.

activation_trace.role: Attaining a proper time or ripeness supplies the focus's latent acquisition window.
Reaching to take supplies the acquisition that the closed window now prevents.
An appointment that bounds a promise by time or place supplies the fixed event threshold.
Deferral to a later time supplies one prohibited direction of movement around the threshold.
Advancing ahead supplies the opposite prohibited direction, locking the appointment.
Grief over a missed matter supplies the affective state that appears only after seeing punishment.
Coming and obtaining presence supplies truth's completed arrival before the late declaration.

structural_cues: 34:29 asks when the promise is; 34:30 answers with a day that cannot shift by an hour.
34:33 locates regret at sight of punishment, and 34:49 marks truth as already arrived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed appointment, post-sight regret, and completed arrival; I infer that reaching in 34:52 cannot run backward across that boundary. The alternative is a purely spatial denial with no maturation or deadline component.

changed_reading.before: Distance means that the object is too far away now.
changed_reading.after: Distance also means that the valid acquisition moment is behind them; a declaration cannot be projected backward into the missed appointment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah explicitly defines what does and does not bring a person near: assets and descendants do not, while heart-settled faith is coupled with sound purposive action and security. The focus's bare late profession lacks the lived near-making trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Place and standing supply a focus position that can be relational as well as geometric.
Immaterial as well as spatial remoteness supplies the focus's negative relation.
Nearness as the opposite of distance supplies the relation that possessions fail to produce.
Nearness and standing supply the destination of the verse's approach relation.
Heart-settled assent appears in the route from belief to attained security, not merely as a spoken label.
Purposive action supplies enacted traversal rather than instantaneous verbal repositioning.
Soundness opposed to corruption qualifies the action paired with faith.

structural_cues: 34:37 grammatically rejects wealth and children as agents of nearness, then excepts the one who believed and acted soundly.
The same verse links belief to secure habitation, while 34:52 presents only a late speech act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit near-making test and couples faith with action; I project that relational metric onto the focus's far place. A live alternative is that 34:37 tests faith's fruits while 34:52's distance remains only spatial-temporal.

changed_reading.before: Far is a geometric description unrelated to the content of their profession.
changed_reading.after: Far also names a relation that status, assets, or instantaneous wording cannot cross; faith had an enacted path into nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speech categorically refuses belief in the recited object and holds faith in negation or counterfactual blame, even while revelation and warning stand in the foreground. The final profession is a new utterance after an accessible relation was repeatedly refused.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the final profession as one utterance in a longer discourse history.
Heart-settled assent supplies the state that the late utterance claims to have reached.
Spoken refusal followed by exchanged blame supplies evidence that declarations can reverse while remaining speech.
The grouped occurrences hold belief first under categorical negation and later in an unrealized counterfactual.
Reading and recitation supply the previously available object explicitly refused.
What stands between or before the hands supplies foreground proximity rather than lack of access.
Covering or blocking truth supplies the immediately stated prior relation to the object.

structural_cues: 34:31 says 'we will never believe' before staging counterfactual believer-language in the blame exchange.
34:46 puts warning before their hands, and 34:53 explicitly contrasts the final claim with prior disbelief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit earlier refusal, foregrounded warning, and prior disbelief; I infer that the speech history blocks retroactive repositioning. Their final words may still be sincere as present recognition, but sincerity need not restore the lost opportunity.

changed_reading.before: A late declaration might itself establish the faith it names.
changed_reading.after: The declaration may register present recognition, but speech cannot rewrite prior refusal or reconstruct the earlier relation of access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, escape is denied and they are taken from a near place; then their own reaching is denied from a far place. Near and far are therefore agent-relative: they remain fully within capture range while standing outside acquisition range.

activation_trace.role: Taking by extension supplies the failed outbound grasp from their side.
Remoteness supplies their position relative to the object they seek.
Failure of attainment or escape closes their attempted movement away.
Seizure and capture supply the successful incoming action upon them.
Place supplies the shared coordinate frame for the paired near and far constructions.
Nearness opposed to distance marks them as readily reachable by the capturing agency.

structural_cues: 34:51 and 34:52 are adjacent and mirror 'from a near place' with 'from a far place.'
The grammatical subject of successful taking differs from the possessors denied successful reaching.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored place phrases and opposite success values; I infer a directional asymmetry of agency. The alternative is that near only locates capture and far only marks the impossibility of return, without a broader agency model.

changed_reading.before: Distance is a single neutral gap applying equally in every direction.
changed_reading.after: They are near enough to be taken yet too far to take hold: judgment reaches them, but their late claim cannot reach back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending contrasts two trajectories: truth is cast by one who knows the hidden and then arrives, whereas they cast speech at the hidden from the same distant place named in the focus. Reaching requires contact; their established epistemic method substitutes projection for contact.

activation_trace.role: Extension until contact and taking supplies the focus's standard of successful epistemic acquisition.
Throwing over distance supplies an incoming trajectory whose payload is truth.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the character of that incoming payload.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the domain known by the source of the truthful casting.
Coming into presence supplies truth's completed arrival and availability.
Throwing words supplies their opposite, outbound trajectory as verbal projection.
The hidden supplies the unseen target at which their words are projected.
Remoteness repeats the focus position and makes projection replace contact.

structural_cues: 34:48 and 34:53 repeat the same casting root with different agents and objects.
34:49 states that truth has arrived between those castings, while 34:52-53 repeat the distant-place frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated casting, opposed payloads, truth's arrival, and the shared distant place; I infer a contrast between grounded reception and speculative projection. A live alternative is that casting merely describes their prior claims and does not explain the failed profession.

changed_reading.before: They cannot reach because they are physically or temporally far away.
changed_reading.after: They also failed by method: instead of receiving arrived truth through contact, they projected words toward the unseen and finally tried to bridge the resulting distance with another utterance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah progressively closes every possible relay: invoked agents control nothing, mediation requires permission, no person controls benefit for another that day, and a barrier is placed between them and what they desire. The focus denies not only reach but transferable rescue.

activation_trace.role: Taking hold of an afflicted one to extract them supplies the focus's possible rescue channel.
Possession and power of disposal supply the control that the invoked agents are explicitly denied.
An intercessor joining another supplies a possible mediating relay.
Permission supplies the gate condition that restricts whether mediation can operate.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the outcome that no person controls for another that day.
An intervening barrier supplies the final physical-relational severance from the desired object.

structural_cues: 34:22-23 uses negation and exception to remove ownership, partnership, support, and unlicensed mediation.
34:42 says that day no one controls benefit for another, and 34:54 ends with an imposed barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies progressively blocked agents, permissions, benefits, and access; I map those closures onto the focus root's delivery and rescue branches. The live alternative is that tanawush denotes only their own grasping and not any third-party transfer.

changed_reading.before: The question denies only their personal ability to grasp faith.
changed_reading.after: It denies the entire transfer architecture: neither self-reach, proxy delivery, mediation, nor extraction can now carry the desired outcome to them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the eaten staff episode as a material analogy for epistemic belatedness. It remains anchored through the focus's ripeness, reaching, and distance branches and the episode's delay-collapse-disclosure sequence. Downstream prose should label it a cross-episode analogy, not a lexical meaning of tanawush.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَأَنَّى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ as attempted recovery after delayed disclosure

activation_trace.role: Attaining proper time or ripeness supplies the focus's belated-recognition axis.
Reaching to recover an object supplies the post-disclosure attempt.
Delay past a thing's time supplies the material prop's extension of a false present.
A noisy, unstable fall supplies the abrupt collapse that ends the delay.
Appearance and disclosure supply the recognition produced only after collapse.
The hidden supplies what the workers could not know during their prolonged condition.

changed_reading.before: They recognize reality too late to act on it.
changed_reading.after: As with a support whose collapse finally exposes the hidden state, post-collapse recognition cannot recover what the period of delayed disclosure consumed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the reach-root's limited combat-contact image and the speech-root's negotiation branch into the final profession. It remains anchored in qalu, tanawush, and the surah's reciprocal blame-speech. Downstream prose should present it as a controlled parley metaphor, not as a claim that the verse literally depicts combat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالُوا آمَنَّا with التناوش as an attempted engagement from outside effective range

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over a matter supplies a possible parley function for the declaration.
Mutual engagement at weapon-reach but short of full contact supplies the range-limited encounter.
Returning speech or answer supplies the reciprocal blame exchange that resembles adversarial negotiation.
Repeated speech exchanged over responsibility supplies the contested matter of the parley.
The denial of benefit from one party to another supplies the failure of any negotiated outcome.

changed_reading.before: Their words merely report a newly held belief.
changed_reading.after: Their profession can be carried as a failed offer of parley from beyond effective engagement range, after reciprocal speech can no longer alter the outcome.

strongest_changes: The near/far pair becomes directionally asymmetric: they are within capture range but outside return reach.
The Saba route sequence makes final remoteness an engineered collapse of formerly safe connectivity.
The fixed appointment turns spatial distance into irreversible temporal distance.
The paired casting scenes distinguish contact with arrived truth from projecting speech at the unseen.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converts the focus's compact reach image into route engineering, event timing, relational nearness, speech history, and opposed trajectories without requiring those mechanisms to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the final profession is inwardly sincere but ineffective, or only another verbal projection, remains open.
Whether tanawush activates rescue and mediation as well as self-grasping remains branch-dependent.
The delayed-staff and failed-parley readings are useful analogical outliers but should not control a conservative rendering.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Belief is voiced after the reach relation has inverted.** `ء م ن/B002` is trusting assent, the variant-rich `ء ن ي/B005` supplies the “whence/how” inquiry, `ن و ش/B001` reaching to take, and `ب ع د/B001` remoteness. Speech now claims assent, but the rhetorical question places grasp at an impossible distance. Assent is the desired object, reach the required operation, and remoteness the blocking geometry. The packet gives the impossibility question; I infer that belief requires timely contact, not verbal declaration after capture. The ayah reads lateness spatially: what is finally wanted can no longer be reached.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:53 explained the remoteness as self-produced by prior covering and distant projection; 34:54 then materialized it as an intervening barrier.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Temporal delay converted into failed spatial reach.** `ن و ش B001` supplies reaching to take something, `ن و ش B004` reaching to pull someone out or rescue, `ء ن ي B005` a whence-or-how inquiry, and `ب ع د B001` remoteness. Their declaration comes after seizure in 34:51 and is pictured as reaching from a far place; 34:54 then places a barrier before desire. The branches assign late belief the role of attempted grasp or self-rescue. The packet supplies sequence and spatialization; I infer that delay has become distance. The rhetorical question reads as geometry of irreversibility, not simple skepticism about sincerity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:54 made the failed reach concrete by installing `ح و ل B005` between subjects and desired object. The later barrier confirmed that `ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ` is not merely difficult retrieval but a route that no longer exists.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4: Deferred Belief Becomes a Geometry of Capture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Once panic arrives, the former freedom to defer is translated into spatial relations: seizure is near, belief is sought from far away, speculative speech is projected toward the unseen, and a barrier closes access to desire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The `ق ذ ف` field reverses the effective projection of truth in 34:48 into distant verbal throwing at the unseen in 34:53, making distance a difference in epistemic warrant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Belated Reach and Distant Projection
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Belief is asserted after the decisive moment, but grasping from afar fails while unsupported speech is thrown toward what remains unseen.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reaching or taking hold (`quranic:root_001565:B001/m01`), remoteness (`quranic:root_000131:B001/m01`), assent of belief (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`), verbal accusation or casting (`quranic:root_001209:B002/m01`), distance extended like travel (`quranic:root_001209:B003/m01`), the unseen (`quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The problem is no longer lack of verbal assent but loss of reach. Earlier conjectural projection toward the unseen has produced the very remoteness from which valid belief cannot now be grasped.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمن ضد الخوف، والأمان وإعطاء الأمنة، والأمانة ضد الخيانة وما اؤتمن عليه، والآمن والمأمن والاستئمان، والأمين والمأمون وما يوثق به، ومنه وثاقة الناقة الأمون.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تصديق الإيمان من حيث هو تصديق، ولا صيغة آمين في الدعاء، ولا أمن المركبة من أم ومن في قوله أمن هو قانت.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمن ضد الخوف (ayn;sihah)؛ أصل الأمن طمأنينة النفس وزوال الخوف (mufradat)؛ الأمانة ضد الخيانة ومعناها سكون القلب (maqayis)؛ الأمان إعطاء الأمنة (maqayis;ayn)؛ أمن فلان يأمن أمنا وأمانا وأمنة فهو آمن (tahdhib)؛ استأمن إليه دخل في أمانه (sihah)؛ مأمنه منزله الذي فيه أمنه (mufradat)؛ الأمون الناقة الأمينة الوثيقة أو التي يؤمن فتورها وعثورها (ayn;sihah;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarıdaki şeye uzanma, erişme ve onu alma örneğini bütünüyle korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişiyi güçlü yakalama ya da böyle bir güce sahip olma bağlamında kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir şeye erişerek onu alma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal el kullanımını kurucu sınır yapar; bu dalın çekirdeği ise erişip almadır ve yalnızca elle yapılan eylemle sınırlı değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Almadan önce nesneye uzanıp erişme işlemini belirgin biçimde içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Elde tutma, bir araya toplama ve sözü aktarma gibi daha geniş alma türlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir nesneyi alma ve kişinin erişimine geçirme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal uzanma ve erişme yolunu korur; komşu dal ise alma, elde tutma ve toplama sonuçlarını daha geniş bir kapsamda birleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Erişilebilir durumdaki şeyi gerçekten alma eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Alma ya da vurmayı mümkün kılan yakınlık durumunu, eylem gerçekleşmeden de bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de bir nesneye erişebilecek mesafede bulunma düşüncesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal erişmeyi mümkün kılan yakınlığı anlatır; bu dal o olanaktan yararlanıp nesneye erişerek onu alma eylemini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Herhangi bir şeyi erişip alma çekirdeğini sonuç şartı olmadan taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tehlikedeki kişiyi bulunduğu durumdan çıkarıp kurtarma sonucunu şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birine ya da bir şeye erişip onu tutma hareketini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel alma eylemidir; komşu dal aynı erişme hareketini yalnızca tehlikedeki kişiyi çıkarma ve kurtarma yapısı içinde kullanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü karşılaştırıldı; seçilenler el ile alma, genel edinme, erişme uzaklığı ve kurtarma sonucu bakımından dalın sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النوش والتناوش والانتياش بمعنى التناول الحسي أو المعنوي، ومد اليد إلى الشيء، وتناول الماء أو الثمر من موضع، والأخذ بالرأس أو اللحية، وما وصف بالقوة على البطش.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الإبطاء أو التأخر أو الطلب إذا جعل من المهموز نأش، ولا رقة لحم الناقة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح يدل على تناول الشيء (maqayis)؛ النوش التناول (ayn;mufradat)؛ ناشت الظبية الأراك تنوشه وتنتاشه أي تناولته (ayn)؛ ناشه ينوشه نوشا، تتناول ماء الحوض من فوق، رجل نؤوش أي ذو بطش، التناوش التناول والانتياش مثله (sihah)؛ التناوش التناول والنوش مثله (tahdhib)؛ تناوش القوم كذا تناولوه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli geçişli yapı içinde bir kişiyi iyiliğe, bir tanıklıkta ise iyiliğe ya da kötülüğe eriştirme anlamını doğrudan destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca bu geçişli söz diziminde başkasını iyi ya da kötü bir sonuca eriştirmeyi kapsar; genel alma veya genel verme anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişiyi iyiliğe ya da kötülüğe eriştiren belirli geçişli yapıya bağlıdır; bağımsız ve genel bir kök anlamı olarak sunulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli geçişli yapıda bir kişiyi iyiliğe ya da kötülüğe eriştirmek, o sonucu ona ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, kendisine ulaştırılan iyilik ya da kötülüğün erişeni durumuna getirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Yapı başkasına bir iyilik ulaştırmayı bildirir; toplu kanıt, kapsamın kötülük ulaştırmaya da açılabildiğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: birini iyiliğe ya da kötülüğe eriştirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca belirtilen geçişli yapıda, bir sonucu başka bir kişiye ulaştırma anlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başka kişinin iyi ya da kötü bir sonuca eriştirilmesini bütünüyle korur.

contextual_glosses.text: birine iyilik ya da kötülük ulaştırmak
contextual_glosses.applicability: Yapının iyi veya kötü bir sonucu bir başkasına eriştirdiği cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sonucun iyi ya da kötü oluşunu ve başka kişiye ulaştırılmasını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birine iyilik ya da kötülük ulaştırmak

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi, iyiliği veya kötülüğü birine verme ve ona ayırma kapsamını daha genel biçimde taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de iyilik veya kötülüğün başka bir kişiye yöneltilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli geçişli yapıda alıcının sonuca erişmesini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise şeyi birine verme veya onun için ayırma eylemini daha geniş kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ulaştırılan içeriği iyilik ya da kötülük olarak sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her tür nesnenin veya içeriğin başkasına ulaştırılmasını kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin başka bir kişiye erişmesini sağlama eylemini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal ulaştırılan şey bakımından geneldir; bu dal ise kalıba bağlı olarak iyilik veya kötülüğün kişiye eriştirilmesini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İyiliğin yanında kötülüğün ulaştırılmasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başkasına mal ya da yarar kazandırmayı ve onun adına edinmeyi öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de başka bir kişinin iyi bir şeye erişmesi sağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yarar ve mal kazandırmaya yöneliktir; bu dal iyiliğin yanı sıra kötülüğü de kapsar ve belirli bir geçişli yapıyla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişiyi iyi ya da kötü bir sonuca eriştirme ilişkisini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Somut bir şeyi verme veya getirip hazır etme eylemlerini genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir içerik başka bir kişiye ulaştırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel verme ve getirme alanındadır; bu dal ise yalnızca belirli yapıda iyilik ya da kötülüğün kişiye eriştirilmesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen karşılaştırmalar kalıba bağlı anlamı genel ulaştırma, yarar kazandırma ve verme alanlarından ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفعل المتعدي نشت الرجل أو نشته بمعنى أنلته خيرا أو شرا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد تناول الشيء للفاعل نفسه، ولا المناوشة في القتال، ولا الإنقاذ من الهلكة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نشته خيرا إذا أنلته خيرا (maqayis)؛ ونشت الرجل نوشا أنلته خيرا أو شرا (ayn)؛ نشته خيرا أي أنلته (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin iki parçası, savaşan tarafların çatışma uzaklığına girmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Bir anlatım yaklaşmayı, diğeri ise mızraklarla erişirken bütünüyle yanaşmamayı belirginleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal savaş içindeki karşılıklı erişme ve saldırmayla sınırlıdır; genel yaklaşma, kovalamaca, düello veya savaş dışı alma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca savaş bağlamındaki karşılıklı yaklaşma ve saldırma yapısına bağlıdır; genel bir yaklaşma ya da alma anlamına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Savaşan iki tarafın birbirlerinin saldırı erimine girecek kadar yaklaşarak karşılıklı çatışmasıdır. Bu çatışma mızraklarla ve taraflar bütünüyle yanaşmadan gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Savaşan taraflar birbirlerine saldırabilecekleri uzaklığa girer ve karşılıklı çatışır.
Karşılıklı saldırı mızraklarla, taraflar bütünüyle yanaşmadan gerçekleştirilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bir anlatım tarafların yaklaşmasını, diğeri mızraklarla erişirken tam yanaşmamalarını öne çıkarır; ortak çekirdek savaşta karşılıklı saldırı uzaklığına girmektir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Savaşan tarafların birbirlerine saldırabilecekleri uzaklığa girerek çatışmasını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tarafların yaklaşmasını ve birbirlerine karşılıklı saldırmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tarafların bütünüyle yakın dövüşe girmeden mızraklarla birbirlerine eriştiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mızraklarla karşılıklı saldırmayı ve tarafların tam yanaşmamasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Mızrakların birbirine dolaşmasını ve mızrakla saplama eylemini özellikle içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal tarafların birbirine erişecek kadar yaklaşmasını anlatır; komşu dal mızrakların fiziksel olarak birbirine girmesine ve saplama eylemine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Savaşan tarafların yaklaşmasını ve birbirlerine saldırmasını bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılıklı saldırı uzaklığına girip doğrudan çatışmayı içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yaklaşarak karşılıklı saldırmadır; komşu dal ise hareketli takip, yüklenme ve aldatıcı geri çekilme düzenidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tarafların birbirlerine erişecek ölçüde yaklaşarak çatışmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tarafların veya kişilerin savaşmak üzere meydana çıkmasını ve düelloya girişini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de karşıtların savaşmak için yüz yüze gelmesini gerektirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı karşılaştırıldı; seçilenler bu dalı mızrak teması, kovalamaca ve düelloya çıkma gibi yakın savaş kavramlarından ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki örnekte de tehlikedeki kişiye erişme, onu bulunduğu durumdan çıkarma ve böylece kurtarma dizisini açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca kişiyi karanlık veya yok oluş tehlikesinden çıkaran kurtarma yapısını kapsar; genel alma ya da genel kurtarma anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tehlikedeki kişiye erişip onu çıkarma yapısına bağlıdır; yalın biçimde her türlü alma veya kurtarma eylemi olarak sunulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tehlikedeki kişiye uzanıp erişerek onu bulunduğu karanlık ya da yok oluş durumundan çıkarma ve kurtarma eylemidir.

facets.statement: Tehlikedeki kişiye erişilir ve kişi bulunduğu zararlı durumdan çıkarılır.
Çıkarma işlemi kişiyi karanlıktan veya yok oluş tehlikesinden kurtarma sonucuna ulaşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, karanlıktan çıkarma ile yok oluş tehlikesinden kurtarmayı aynı erişme, çekip çıkarma ve güvene kavuşturma dizisinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tehlikedeki kişiye erişme, onu zararlı durumdan çıkarma ve kurtarma dizisinin tamamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tehlikedeki kişiye erişmeyi ve onu çıkararak kurtarmayı birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da tehlikedeki kişiyi zararlı durumdan çıkarıp kurtarmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal kurtarmanın konusu ve yöntemi bakımından geneldir; bu dal kişiye erişip onu karanlık ya da yok oluş tehlikesinden çıkaran yapıyla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tehlikedeki kişiye erişip onu çıkararak güvene kavuşturmayı içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişiyi bulunduğu tehlikeli durumdan fiilen çekip çıkarma eylemini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sığınana güvence verme, onu koruma altına alma ve zulmü engelleme ilişkisini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de tehlikedeki bir kişinin zarar görmesi önlenir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal koruyucu güvence ve sığınma ilişkisine dayanır; bu dal kişiye erişip onu mevcut tehlikeden çıkarma eylemine dayanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Erişme ve tutma hareketini kişiyi tehlikeden çıkarma sonucuna bağlar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal birine ya da bir şeye erişip onu tutma hareketini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel erişip alma çekirdeğidir; bu dal aynı hareketin tehlikedeki kişiyi dışarı çıkarıp kurtaran özel yapısıdır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المهموز انتأش بمعنى تأخر أو انتزع، ولا مجرد تناول الشيء بلا معنى إخراج أو إنقاذ.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yalnızca eti ince olan dişi deveyi niteleyen özel betimlemeyi verir. Genel incelik ya da erişip alma anlamı için bu dalda kanıt yoktur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli dişi deve betimlemesiyle sınırlıdır; başka hayvanlara, genel zayıflığa veya kökün erişip alma ağına yayılmaz.

facets.statement: Betimlenen dişi devenin eti incedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kapsam tek ve kalıplaşmış bir dişi deve betimlemesiyle sınırlıdır.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, eti ince olan dişi deveyi belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca eti ince ve az olan dişi deveye özgü betimleme olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın dişi deve oluşunu ve etinin ince olmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözlük biriminin belirttiği hayvan niteliğini açıklayan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dişi devenin etinin ince ve az oluşunu açık biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesnelerin, bedenin, sözün veya davranışın genel inceliğini ve yumuşaklığını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir şeyin ince olması ortak niteliktir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal incelik ve yumuşaklığı geniş bir alanda anlatır; bu dal yalnızca dişi devenin etinin inceliğini belirten kalıpla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnızca dişi devenin ince etli oluşunu durağan bir nitelik olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Etin zayıflık yüzünden çekilmesini veya buruşmasını ve çeşitli canlıların cılızlığını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da hayvan bedenindeki et niteliğiyle ilişkilidir.

morphemes_tsv.note: ayah attribution taken from qac_ref, with non-surah rows and standalone basmala ayah marker rows (1:0) filtered out | dropped_preface_rows=7

word_morpheme_spans.note: Ordered surface alignment within canonical QAC words; only spans shared by all best alignments are joined. Upstream word-analysis identities and wording are preserved. Unresolved analytic units remain available for qualified reading; never infer their QAC identity from upstream numbering.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

missing_branch_inventories.reason: no accepted, non-contaminated branch inventory in resource

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
